messages:
alex-sdr: Putting NeoQuill POC on your radar — they're asking for SSO + SCIM + RBAC + domain controls. timeline: 3-week eval, need pricing and blockers asap

jordan-se: Thanks — quick Qs: will they use hosted Redwood API or Dedicated/reserved GPUs for the POC? that changes pricing + network setup

alex-sdr: Sales call said they want hosted to start, but they'd consider Dedicated if latency/throughput is a blocker. also asked about private deployment down the line (VPC)

emma-eng: For hosted + SAML: we support SP-initiated and IdP-initiated flows. SAML attributes we typically rely on: email, groups, role. what's their IdP? Okta? Ping me if they need multiple audience assertions

alex-sdr: They use OneLogin and Azure AD in pockets across teams — want group sync and ability to map SCIM groups -> app roles

jordan-se: SCIM details: we need to confirm delta vs full export support and throttle limits. can we share our SCIM rate guidance and minimal required attributes?

max-infra: SCIM: we support SCIM 2.0 delta patch + bulk. recommended default throttle: 60 reqs/min on hosted; can increase for Dedicated. sample header we expect: `Authorization: Bearer <token>` and `Content-Type: application/scim+json`

emma-eng: RBAC mapping: we support mapping groups -> roles via the Console; can do role import via SCIM groups. note: nested group flattening happens during provisioning, mention if they rely on large nested hierarchies

alex-sdr: Any enterprise blockers (legal/compliance) we should flag before call with their SecOps next Tuesday?

linda-legal: Standard asks: data residency, audit logs retention, and whether PII in attributes is stored. For hosted POC we can provide 90-day audit retention for the POC and a Data Processing Addendum. also they asked about signed SAML metadata and SAML certificate rotation policy

emma-eng: Signed metadata: yes. cert rotation: we support uploading new certs and can do overlapping cert windows to avoid downtime. for private/VPC we support HSM/KMS integration for key material

alex-sdr: Pricing and commit question: they want ballpark cost if they switch to Dedicated after POC — also how we price SCIM-heavy usage (lots of provisioning calls)

jordan-se: Pricing notes: Hosted billed per-token + per-embedding units. Dedicated is reserved GPU pricing (monthly commit) + nominal infra usage. SCIM provisioning on hosted is not metered separately but extreme rates can incur additional infra fees — we'll surface if they hit the throttle and propose a burst plan. I'll request a draft quote from finance

sophie-ps: I'll own the POC runbook and interim deliverables. Proposed checklist before call: 1) IdP metadata (SAML), 2) SCIM service account + token, 3) example group csv, 4) list of protected domains for domain verification, 5) success criteria for RBAC. Can we confirm owners?

alex-sdr: I'll get IdP metadata + group csv. NeoQuill will provide SCIM token once we share endpoint.

max-infra: Note on domain controls: we support domain verification via TXT dns or email verification for single domains; for enterprise multi-tenant they may need domain proofing + delegated admin. For private deployments, we can sync internal DNS if requested

linda-legal: Also flag: they asked for SOC2-type evidence and pen test windows. we can share SOC2 report under NDA and offer a pen test window for Dedicated/private options

jordan-se: Action items summarized: 1) share SCIM rate guidance + sample SCIM request (I'll paste below), 2) draft Dedicated ballpark from finance, 3) PS runbook from Sophie, 4) legal checklist and SOC2 access from Linda. ETA: EOD tomorrow for the docs, quote early next week

devops-bot: Preflight checklist template attached — runbook snippet:
```
# POC preflight
- IdP SAML metadata (x2)
- SCIM token with test user scope
- Test groups (<=50)
- Domain TXT for verification ready
- Contact for failover (phone/email)
```

alex-sdr: perfect. I'll schedule a 30m secops + infra sync for Tue 10:30 PT and add the NeoQuill tech lead. thanks everyone :thumbsup:

jordan-se: I'll bring the SCIM example payload and an RBAC mapping snapshot.

emma-eng: I'll prep notes on certificate rotation and KMS options.

linda-legal: Will prepare the NDA access link and SOC2 instructions.

sophie-ps: I'll drop the runbook into the shared drive and invite NeoQuill to the trial workspace once IdP metadata is in.

alex-sdr: closing for now, will post updates in the thread after the call.
